CHAPTER.VERS: »If only you were like my brother, that sucked the breasts of my mother! When I find you outside I would kiss you. I would not be despised.
»I would lead you to my mother's house. She would instruct me. I would induce you to drink of spiced wine of the juice of my pomegranate.
»His left hand should be under my head, and his right hand should embrace me.
»I charge you, O daughters of Jerusalem, do not stir me up or awake my love until he pleases.«
»Who is this woman who comes up from the wilderness, leaning upon her beloved?« »I raised you up under the apple tree. There your mother experienced birth pains.«
»Set me as a signature ring seal upon your heart, as a seal upon your arm. For Love is as strong as death. Zeal is as fixed as the grave. And zeal burns like coals of fire, the very flame of Jehovah.
»Many waters cannot quench love. Rivers cannot wash it away. If a man would give all the riches of his house for love, it would be utterly despised.«
»We have a little sister, and she has no breasts. What shall we do for our sister in the day when she will be spoken for?
»If she were a wall, we would build upon her a palace of silver. If she were a door, we would enclose her with boards of cedar.«
»I am a wall, and my breasts are like towers. I was the one who found favor in his eyes.
»Solomon had a vineyard at Baal-hamon. He leased the vineyard to keepers. Every one was to bring a thousand pieces of silver for its fruit.«
»My vineyard, which is mine, is before me. You, O Solomon, must have a thousand, and those that tend the fruit two hundred.«
»You who dwell in the gardens, the companions listen to your voice. Cause me to hear it.«
»Make haste, my beloved, and be like a gazelle or a young stag upon the mountains of spices.«
